source_clauses: compact folding stand for my desk
three legs that fold in close to the body
whole thing becomes narrow and compact when I put it away
Everything should stay attached while it is folded
I do not want to take anything off to fold it, or loose pieces to look after
open it by hand, following a sequence that makes sense as I go
three legs should end up spread apart in different directions so they give the stand a usable footprint on the desk
Nothing should come apart or fall off while I am opening it
I should not need tools, a motor, or any other equipment to do it
Once it is open, it needs to stay open on its own
I should not have to hold the legs while I use it
they should not be able to fold back, twist aside, or come off
Nothing should turn on its own, shift out of place, or move in some other direction I was not expecting
Before it can be folded again I want to have to do something deliberate, so it does not collapse just because I knocked it
After that deliberate release, it should fold back down to the same compact shape it started in
opening and folding sequence should be repeatable
all normal parts remaining attached and without anything needing to be removed and put back on
It is meant to hold a small object on my desk while I am working
genuinely be built as a product and put together in a sensible order
stay together through normal opening and folding

requirements.statement: The stand must be compact and folding for desk use.
The stand must have three legs that fold in close to the body.
When folded, the stand must become narrow and compact.
All parts must stay attached while folded.
Folding must not require removing any parts or managing loose pieces.
The user must be able to open the stand by hand.
The opening sequence must make sense as the user goes.
When open, the three legs must be spread apart in different directions.
The open legs must give a usable footprint on the desk.
Nothing may come apart or fall off during opening.
Opening must not require tools, a motor, or any other equipment.
Once open, the stand must stay open on its own.
The user must not have to hold the legs while using the stand.
The legs must not fold back, twist aside, or come off when open.
Nothing may turn, shift, or move in unexpected ways when open.
Folding must require a deliberate release action.
The stand must not collapse from a knock.
After deliberate release, the stand must fold back to the same compact shape.
The opening and folding sequence must be repeatable.
All normal parts must remain attached during repeated opening and folding.
Repeated opening and folding must not require removing and putting back on any parts.
The stand is intended to hold a small object on the desk while working.
The stand must be buildable as a product.
The stand must be assemblable in a sensible order.
The stand must stay together during normal opening and folding.

scenarios.description: User places the stand on the desk in folded condition.
User opens the stand by hand following an intuitive sequence.
User places a small object on the open stand while working.
User deliberately releases the stand before folding.
User folds the stand back to its compact shape.
The stand is assembled in a sensible order during manufacturing.

actors.name: user
actors.must_reach: operate the stand: open, release, fold, place object

actors.name: manufacturer
actors.must_reach: assemble the stand in a sensible order

freedoms: The request does not specify materials.
The request does not specify dimensions.
The request does not specify the type of small object.
The request does not specify the exact number of legs beyond three.
The request does not specify the mechanism for opening, staying open, or deliberate release.
The request does not specify the way the legs fold (e.g., scissors, swivel, etc.).
The request does not specify the shape of the folded stand.
The request does not specify the exact footprint when open.
The request does not specify the surface finish, color, or aesthetics.
The request does not specify cost, weight, or durability.
The request does not specify the desk size or environment.
The request does not specify whether the stand is adjustable.
The request does not specify how the object is held (e.g., rim, clip, tray).
ambiguities: What exactly constitutes 'a sequence that makes sense as I go' is subjective and not defined.
The phrase 'usable footprint' is vague; the required size or stability is not specified.
The phrase 'small object' is ambiguous; no size or weight limit is given.
The phrase 'something deliberate' is not defined; the user must decide what counts as deliberate.
The phrase 'stay open on its own' does not specify the degree of stability required (e.g., under what forces).
The phrase 'normal parts' is ambiguous; it is unclear what parts are considered normal.
The phrase 'sensible order' for assembly is subjective.
The request says 'three legs that fold in close to the body' but does not clarify if the legs are the only structural parts.
The request does not specify whether the stand is meant for temporary or permanent use on the desk.
The request does not specify the orientation of the legs when open (e.g., tripod shape).
assumptions: The stand is intended for indoor desk use only.
The stand is small enough to be placed on a desk and hold a small object.
The user is a typical adult with the ability to operate the stand by hand without assistance.
No external power or tools are required for opening or folding.
The stand will be manufactured from materials that are sufficiently rigid and durable for the intended use.
The repeatable sequence implies the stand is designed for many cycles of opening and folding without wear that would affect function.
The stand is a single object with no separate pieces that must be managed.
